fieldNotes.location: Confirmed Kroger Springdale Ice Cream & Beverage Plant, 11801 Chesterdale Rd, Cincinnati (Springdale) OH 45246. Large single ice-cream/beverage manufacturing building fronted by I-275 to the north and Chesterdale Rd (NE-SW) to the east. Web sources (LinkedIn, IndustryNet, company pages) confirm a Kroger-owned fluid-milk/ice-cream/soda plant opened 1965, 'minutes from I-275 East' — matches the imagery exactly. Supplied coords were essentially correct.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Whole property is wrapped in continuous chain-link perimeter fence behind the Chesterdale Rd guardrail (verified in Street View 2023-09 panos at 39.2905,-84.4479 and 39.2906,-84.4479). Truck access is a single controlled drive off Chesterdale Rd at the SE; the road frontage shows no open curb cut, so vehicles enter through one fenced gate/checkpoint at the parking/yard boundary.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly resolvable staffed guard booth at the entrance in available imagery; a long low gatehouse/canopy structure sits at the parking-to-yard boundary (NE) but could not be positively confirmed as a manned shack. Left guardShack false / remoteGs true (gate present, no confirmed booth) and flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved maneuvering/staging yard between the building's north face and I-275 (the NE apron) holds trailers and trucks inside the fence before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep internal yard on the W, SW and N of the building easily stacks 3+ trucks between the gate and the dock canopies.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cold-chain dock layout: rows of individual white canopies along the W and SW building faces, each covering a single reefer trailer backed to a dock door (z20 imagery). Counted roughly 25-35 canopied/uncovered dock positions across both faces; banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked without tractors in the NE staging yard and along the canopy rows; ~10-25 drop positions.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer storage/staging in the NE paved yard separate from the active dock canopies.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single access drive off Chesterdale Rd serves both in and out (one gated point).
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single inbound lane estimated at the gate drive; could not isolate exact lane count — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Single outbound lane estimated; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the dense Cincinnati metro/Springdale industrial fabric, immediately on I-275 with surrounding office/industrial parks and apartments — Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest infrastructure is the highway, not rail.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large contiguous manufacturing building (dark-roof main plant + attached white-roof cold-storage/freezer addition on the south/SE) — treated as a single building, not a campus.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~22 acres from the fenced operational perimeter polygon; honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh pad identified; left false and flagged uncertain.
